meta.principle: Navy = authority. Brass = the seal (max 10%). White = the stage. Ratio 70/20/10.
meta.note: Contrast ratios approximate — verify with a checker at build time.

700.use: brass text on ivory (large only), pressed accent

600.use: PRIMARY ACCENT — seals, badges, rules, add-to-cart

contrast_rules_approx.steel on white: ~5.9:1 — passes AA body; do not lighten further
contrast_rules_approx.brass-600 on white: ~3.5:1 — LARGE text & UI elements only; NEVER body
contrast_rules_approx.brass-400 on navy-800: ~5:1 — headings/accents on navy, not long text
contrast_rules_approx.semantic text: always the 'value' on white/tint, never on navy

hard_rules.brass_share: ≤10% of any view; one brass moment per view
hard_rules.backgrounds: white default · ivory alternating · navy bands for hero/footer only · never full navy pages
